const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> polyMul(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < need) size <<= 1;
    
    vector<double> ar(size, 0.0), ai(size, 0.0);
    vector<double> br(size, 0.0), bi(size, 0.0);

        ar[i] = x & 32767;
        ai[i] = x >> 15;

        long long x = b[i];
        x = ((x % mod) + mod) % mod;

        bi[i] = x >> 15;

        for (; j & bit; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
        j ^= bit;

        }

        double ang = 2 * M_PI / h;
        double wr = cos(ang);
        double wi = sin(ang);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += h) {
            double w_r = 1.0;
            double w_i = 0.0;
            int half = h >> 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {

                double ui = ai[i + j];
                double vr = ar[i + j + half] * w_r - ai[i + j + half] * w_i;
                double vi = ar[i + j + half] * w_i + ai[i + j + half] * w_r;
                
                ar[i + j] = ur + vr;
                ai[i + j] = ui + vi;
                ar[i + j + half] = ur - vr;
                ai[i + j + half] = ui - vi;
                
                double t = w_r * wr - w_i * wi;
                w_i = w_r * wi + w_i * wr;
                w_r = t;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // FFT for br, bi
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        for (; j & bit; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(br[i], br[j]);
            swap(bi[i], bi[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int h = 2; h <= n; h <<= 1) {
        double ang = 2 * M_PI / h;
        double wr = cos(ang);
        double wi = sin(ang);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += h) {
            double w_r = 1.0;
            double w_i = 0.0;
            int half = h >> 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double ur = br[i + j];
                double ui = bi[i + j];
                double vr = br[i + j + half] * w_r - bi[i + j + half] * w_i;
                double vi = br[i + j + half] * w_i + bi[i + j + half] * w_r;
                
                br[i + j] = ur + vr;
                bi[i + j] = ui + vi;

        double a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;

        double b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;
        
        resr[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;

        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) resk[i] /= n;
    
    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long a = llround(resr[i]);
        long long b = llround(resj[i]);
        long long c = llround(resi[i]);
        res[i] = (int)((a + ((b % mod) << 15) + ((c % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss1(line);
    int n, k;
    ss1 >> n >> k;
    
    vector<int> poly(10, 0);
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss2(line);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx;
        ss2 >> idx;
        poly[idx] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            ans = polyMul(ans, poly, MOD);
        }
        poly = polyMul(poly, poly, MOD);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    
    long long res = 0;
    for (int v : ans) {
        res = (res + (long long)v * v) % MOD;
    }
    cout << res << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
